title: Physical class-space causal transfer after R1C and Canary-v2
prospective_refinement: The older planning sketch for CS-TRANSFER-001 used long arithmetic/numeric runs. Before execution, completed R1C and Canary-v2 localized the live uncertainty: inactive-class masking is not sufficient, extended exposure rescues broad formation, but identity/copy remains weak. This preregistration therefore makes the first executed CS-TRANSFER-001 a cleaner physical-vocabulary intervention with token-isomorphic data and matched shared initialization. The old planning document remains historical evidence and is not rewritten.
primary_question: At 8L/256w, does reducing the actual tied embedding/output matrix from 24,576 rows to 4,096 rows causally improve identity/copy formation when the two arms receive byte-identical token sequences, matched shared parameter initialization, matched optimizer/schedule/stream, and the same frozen production tokenizer encoding surface?

causal_contrast.token_sequences: byte-identical across paired arms; every content token ID is <4096
causal_contrast.tokenizer: same frozen 24576-entry production tokenizer artifact is used only to render/select the shared low-ID text surface; tokenizer bytes never differ between arms
causal_contrast.shared_initialization: all non-embedding tensors are copied byte-identically from the same V24576 reference initialization; rows 0..4095 of the tied embedding are copied byte-identically; V24576 alone owns rows 4096..24575

model.parameter_difference_is_treatment: The parameter-count difference is exactly the removed/added tied embedding rows. Width, depth and every non-embedding tensor shape are identical; compensatory widening is forbidden because it would introduce a second architectural intervention.

data.selection: deterministic hash-ranked selection after low-ID eligibility; selection uses no model outcome
data.split_rule: retain original latent-world train/development/sealed split; sealed candidate worlds are generated before training and selected/hash-bound before any update
mandatory_screens: all selected content IDs <4096 and no PAD/BOS/EOS/UNK content IDs
shortcut baselines <0.35 on selected development rows
at least 15% candidate acceptance for every family/split
identical selected token-sequence manifest used by both physical-vocabulary arms

matching.pairing: seed i: PHYS_4096 and PHYS_24576 share model seed, order seed, selected data bytes, pack manifest, update count, token budget, optimizer hyperparameters and schedule

training.optimizer: production AdamW beta(0.9,0.95), eps 1e-8, selective wd 0.1
training.objective: canonical causal CE, EOS included, aux lambdas 0
training.schedule: token-indexed canary WSD: 10% warmup, stable through 85%, linear decay to 0.1x peak; peak 3e-4; no rewarm
training.precision: CUDA FP32 primary for clean paired causality; no BF16 difference between arms

evaluation.primary_metric: paired identity FORMATION_AUC over fixed development checkpoints using exact token answer + valid EOS
evaluation.co_primary_endpoint: paired identity exact-token-with-valid-EOS gap at update 480
secondary: extra-row V24576 norm and logit mass
evaluation.sealed: consumed once only after all eight arms reach update 480 and development results are frozen; no sealed score can alter training or arm inclusion
evaluation.metric_contract: token-level comparison is authoritative; text decode is a secondary audit only. This avoids the Canary-v2 answer_prefix_exact diagnostic ambiguity.

decision_rule.SUPPORTED_PHYSICAL_CLASS_SPACE: mean paired identity AUC gap PHYS_4096-PHYS_24576 >=0.10, gap positive in >=3/4 seed pairs, and mean paired identity endpoint gap >=0.10; mechanical gates pass and at least one non-identity control family forms in both arms
decision_rule.STRONG_PHYSICAL_CLASS_SPACE: SUPPORTED criteria plus mean paired identity AUC gap >=0.20 and sealed identity endpoint gap >=0.10 after one-shot sealed evaluation
decision_rule.PARTIAL_OR_INTERACTION: mean paired identity AUC gap is between 0.05 and 0.10, or >=0.10 but positive in <3/4 pairs, or primary and endpoint signs disagree
decision_rule.NULL_AT_THIS_SCALE: absolute mean paired identity AUC gap <0.05 and absolute endpoint gap <0.05, with >=3/4 pairs individually within +/-0.10
decision_rule.REVERSE_EFFECT: mean paired identity AUC gap <=-0.10 and PHYS_24576 wins in >=3/4 pairs
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE_FORMATION: neither arm establishes the preregistered control-formation floor in >=3/4 matched pairs
decision_rule.FAIL_ENGINEERING: any mandatory identity/data/resume/numerics/evaluation integrity gate fails

control_formation_floor.rule: in each arm/seed, at least one of composition or termination must reach exact-token-with-valid-EOS >=0.50 by update 480
control_formation_floor.purpose: a class-space comparison is not interpretable when neither arm demonstrates basic formation

post_result_actions.SUPPORTED_PHYSICAL_CLASS_SPACE: replicate the physical contrast at the ~40M development rung and only then decide whether vocabulary_size should change in V5.1; do not jump to 500M
post_result_actions.STRONG_PHYSICAL_CLASS_SPACE: same as SUPPORTED, with higher priority; still requires tokenizer/representation transfer before architecture freeze
post_result_actions.PARTIAL_OR_INTERACTION: run a narrow mechanism dissection separating tied-row geometry from denominator competition/weight-decay effects; do not change production vocab
post_result_actions.NULL_AT_THIS_SCALE: deprioritize physical class-space as the explanation for the V2 identity bottleneck; move to identity objective/data/termination and tokenizer-segmentation diagnostics
post_result_actions.REVERSE_EFFECT: retain V24576 as conservative default and investigate why reduced physical class space harms formation
post_result_actions.INCONCLUSIVE_FORMATION: repair exposure/schedule/data validity before any representation inference
post_result_actions.FAIL_ENGINEERING: repair engineering only; preserve scientific preregistration or issue an explicit prospective amendment

claim_ceiling: Controlled development-scale causal evidence about physical tied class-space effects on formation under a shared low-ID production-tokenizer surface. No production tokenizer, corpus, PRE500M, 250M, 500M, cognition, or AGI authorization.
